rationale: The reporter asks how to scope a git credential helper to one project, which is a usage question rather than a defect. The uv git-credentials docs (docs/concepts/authentication/git.md) say that when no credentials are in the URL, the git credential helper is queried, and they recommend a helper or gh auth setup-git; they do not describe project-level helper config. A repo-local git config only applies when git runs inside that repository, and uv fetches git dependencies outside the project tree, so the local helper is likely never read. This last point is my inference and was not checked against uv's source. The one search hit, #1514 (URL-embedded credentials not resolving, closed), describes a different failure and is not a duplicate.
